title: Index and query tokenize Unicode text the same way: CamelCase splits on any letter case, text is NFC, matching is casefolded
goal: kbfacts splits identifiers with non-ASCII capitals (PobierzŁącze -> pobierz, łącze; GetEntityÜbersicht -> get, entity, übersicht), normalizes index text and query to NFC so a decomposed Könige is one word, and compares words casefolded so Straße meets strasse. No setting; ASCII text tokenizes exactly as before, the public eval shares and the collected test ids do not change.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbfacts as k; assert k.CAMEL.findall('PobierzŁącze')==['Pobierz','Łącze'], k.CAMEL.findall('PobierzŁącze'); assert k.CAMEL.findall('GetEntityÜbersicht')==['Get','Entity','Übersicht']

import sys,unicodedata as u; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbfacts as k; a=u.normalize('NFD','Könige'); assert k.terms(a)==k.terms(u.normalize('NFC',a))==k.key_terms(a)[:0]+k.terms('Könige'), k.terms(a); assert k.terms('Straße')==k.terms('strasse'), k.terms('Straße')

gates.question: How does the CamelCase split recognise non-ASCII capitals, given the stdlib re has no Unicode property classes?
options: Scan with str.isupper/islower (stdlib only, one small function replacing the CAMEL regex use)
Spell out Latin-1 and Latin Extended-A/B capital ranges in the regex
gates.recommendation: Scan with str.isupper/islower (stdlib only, one small function replacing the CAMEL regex use)
gates.reason: because it covers every script with case and needs no range table to maintain
gates.answer: Scan with str.isupper/islower (stdlib only, one small function replacing the CAMEL regex use)

gates.question: Does casefolding and NFC apply to identifier-like tokens (path#symbol, CODE symbols, version ids) as well as to prose words?
options: Prose words and split identifier parts only; ids, paths and symbols are compared as written
gates.recommendation: Prose words and split identifier parts only; ids, paths and symbols are compared as written
gates.reason: because a code symbol's case is part of its name and the code map matches it exactly

notes: Premise (run at plan time, commit 459853b lineage): CAMEL.findall('PobierzŁącze') -> ['Pobierz', 'cze']; CAMEL.findall('GetEntityÜbersicht') -> ['Get', 'Entity', 'bersicht']; WORD.findall of NFD 'Könige' -> ['Ko', 'nige'] while the NFC form -> ['Könige']; 'Straße'.lower()=='strasse' is False, .casefold() is True. All reproduce. Baseline: rag.py eval -> questions=774 passed=774 verdict_ok=774 found_ok=774. Readers beyond kbfacts: kf_index.py lower()s query words at many sites and its index cache is keyed on the CAMEL/WORD patterns; kf_route.py lower()s question words; every other caller of terms/key_terms inherits the change and needs no edit. re has no \p{Lu}: the split needs a scan by str.isupper/islower or an explicit class.
